findings.claim: The supplied review evidence must expose the task-owned reducer implementation and focused test matrix sufficiently to assess the lifecycle goal.
findings.observed: The caller-computed diff visibility is incomplete and explicitly omits be-document-processing/src/document_processing/audit/audit_lifecycle_observations.py and be-document-processing/tests/test_monitor_lifecycle_observations.py; their contents were not supplied for review.
findings.rationale: Those omitted paths are the core source and test deliverables for goal-001. The supplied GREEN proof establishes a focused command outcome but cannot substitute for semantic inspection of omitted implementation and tests, so acceptance cannot determine correctness and must not infer that either deliverable is absent.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-supplied diff or equivalent bounded artifacts containing the task-owned reducer and focused tests, then rerun semantic acceptance; do not infer implementation absence from the current omission.
